(to the question) The age of a complete man
The age of a complete man is after he is more than thirteen years and one day, for then he attains the Mochin of birth.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 115:1
items.html:
(to the question) The age of a child of nine years and one day
See answer 90. (Ibid.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 116:1
items.html:
(to the question) The age of a child of eighteen
The age of a child of eighteen is after he receives the Lamed of the Tzelem of the phase of the Mochin of birth, as stated in its place. (Ibid.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 117:1
items.html:
(to the question) The age of the young children
See above, in answer 89. (Ibid.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 118:1
items.html:
(to the question) The first pregnancy
In the first pregnancy, the phase of the Katnut of ZA of Nekudim is corrected in return — that is, the six vessels: HBD, HGT, and the point of the Chazeh, in the level of NHY, which is the light of Nefesh. And it is called three within three, for only the three upper vessels are enlarged in the pregnancy, and the three lower ones are included in them. And at the end of the pregnancy, at the time of birth, AVI couple in the screen of phase 1, from the phase of their middle vessels, and the level of Ruach comes out for ZA; but ZA cannot receive it now, for it is born immediately and falls to BYA, and loses even the phase of the Nefesh of Atzilut. And through its nursing there from the lower two thirds of Atik, which left their record in the NHY of AA of Atzilut, it returns and acquires the Nefesh of Atzilut from the time of the pregnancy, and ascends from BYA and clothes the NHY of AA of Atzilut. (Part 1, Page 152, Item 85). See above, answer 24.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 119:1
items.html:
(to the question) The second pregnancy
The second pregnancy completes the vessels from the Chazeh downward, which were missing after all the correction of the first pregnancy. For in the first pregnancy only the inner vessels were corrected, which are the phase of the vessels within the body, which from the phase of the correction of the lines are called HBD HGT up to the Chazeh, as above in answer 118. And he lacks the AHP, which are the NHY from the Chazeh downward. And these are completed for him in the second pregnancy by the lengthening of the legs of Ima, for the bottom Hey descends from the Einayim, and the AHP of ZA return to their place, and then the ten vessels are completed. And this second pregnancy is the secret of the first union mentioned in AVI and in ZON, to make it a vessel.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 120:1
items.html:
(to the question) The third pregnancy
After he becomes a child of nine years and one day, having already received all the four levels that come by means of the second pregnancy, he then ascends as MAN for the need of the Mochin of birth, called the third pregnancy, or the second pregnancy of Gadlut. And this is by the raising of MAN to AVI from the phase of their Achoraim that fell from the third division of Nekudim, from the MAN of the Vav and the point, which they received from the Yesod of AK. For then Ima removed her Achoraim and returned with Aba face-to-face, and from this phase four levels came out from the phase of the upper AVI, and four levels from the phase of YESHSUT. And according to the measure that ZA raises from these Achoraim, so do the Mochin that he receives by their means grow. And this third pregnancy is called in many places by the name the second pregnancy as well, for he calls the second pregnancy, after the two years of nursing, the second pregnancy of Katnut, and this third pregnancy, which comes after nine years and one day, he calls the second pregnancy of Gadlut. And this is a matter understood from its context. (Part 1, Page 152, Item 86; Part 1, Page 156, Item 92; Page 159, Item 102).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 121:1
items.html:
(to the question) Turbidity of the blood
The coarseness in the vessels of the coupling, which are the vessels of NHY, is called by the name blood. And as long as they have not been corrected with the screen of the upper one, they are discerned as turbid, for the will to receive without a screen is the portion of the shells, as is known. And when they are corrected by the upper one and attain the power of the screen, then they are discerned as having become clear and refined, in a manner that they are fit to couple with the upper light. (Part 1, Page 145, Item 62).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html:
(to the question) Turbidity of the waters
The phases of the bottom Hey of the first restriction, which cannot receive the phase of the coagulation of the Yesod of Aba, which makes ZA into the phase of a firmament (See answer 37.), being included in the MAN of ZA, are discerned as the turbidity of the waters. (Part 1, Page 133, Item 21).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 123:1
items.html:

See answer 76.

items.html:
(to the question) The world of the male
Bina is called the world of the male, relative to her NHY that clothe in ZA, which is male. (Part 1, Page 131, Item 13).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 125:1
items.html:
(to the question) Ten kinds of blood
ZA includes the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot, for from the phase of the fifth Hesed, which is Hod, come out the five Gevurot, being the phase of the Malchut of the five Hassadim, as is known. And relative to the separate Nukva of ZA, ZA is called only the phase of the five Hassadim alone, and the Nukva is entirely the five Gevurot.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html:
(to the question) Inner
There are three Partzufim: the Partzuf of the pregnancy, which is the level of NHY; and the Partzuf of the nursing, which is the level of HGT; and the Partzuf of Gadlut, which is the level of HBD. And they clothe one within the other. The Partzuf of Gadlut clothes from the Chazeh downward, within the Partzuf of the nursing; and the Partzuf of the nursing clothes from the Chazeh downward, within the Partzuf of the pregnancy. Hence the Partzuf of Gadlut is innermost of them all, and is therefore called inner. And the Partzuf of the pregnancy is outermost of them all, and is therefore called outer. And the Partzuf of the nursing is between them, and is therefore called middle. (Part 1, Page 210, Item 214).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 127:1
items.html:
(to the question) Internality of the Katnut of Aba
The VAK of the five Hassadim, which ZA receives from the age of two years until the sixth year and one day, are called the inner ones of the Katnut of Aba. See item 119. (Part 1, Page 186, Item 179).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 128:1
items.html:
(to the question) Internality of the Katnut of Ima
The Nefesh-Ruach of Ruach that ZA receives in the two years of nursing are called the inner ones of the Katnut of Ima. See item 119. (Part 1, Page 184, Items 172 and 173).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 132:1
items.html:
(to the question) The forming of the fetus
The forming of the fetus is made by the phase of the redness of Ima, which is the phase of the coarseness and the screens upon which the coupling is made, that establish the level and conclude each and every organ of ZA in its form. (Part 1, Page 133, Item 21).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 133:1
items.html:
(to the question) Cooling
At the departure of the lights from the vessels, it is discerned that the vessels have cooled, because they have ceased from performing their action. (Part 1, Page 130, Item 8).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 134:1
items.html:
(to the question) Tzeirei
Bina is called Tzeirei, because all the organs of ZA receive their form through the screen of her coarseness. (Part 1, Page 133, Item 21).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 135:1
items.html:
(to the question) Narrow
The abundant influence of the Hassadim is called by the name expansion, or width; and the restriction of the Hassadim is called by the name narrow. But the restriction of Hochma is called by the name short, and its influence by the name long. (Part 1, Page 128, Item 6).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 136:1
items.html:
(to the question) Kista de-Chayei
It is impossible for ZA to have Mochin lower than the inner ones of the Katnut of Ima, which are the phase of the Nefesh-Ruach of Ruach, which it attains in the two years of nursing; and these are called Kasta de-Chayei, meaning the measure of life. For the Mochin above this phase are not in it the measure of life, but only the phase of additional expansion, which do not necessitate permanence, and they are with him passing and returning according to the merit of the lower ones. (Part 1, Page 148, Item 73).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 137:1
items.html:
(to the question) Coagulation
It is known that the phase of the Yesod of Aba is narrow in Hassadim and long in Hochma. For the lack of Hassadim is called narrow (See answer 135), and from this phase of narrow, the light is called the light of coagulation, as it is written, "precious light and coagulation." For even though it is the precious light of Hochma, nevertheless it is in the phase of coagulation and cooling from the lack of Hassadim. Therefore this illumination of the Yesod of Aba is called by the name of the rennet that coagulates the milk, so that it curdles and becomes cheese. For when the female is in the phase of short and wide — meaning short of the illumination of Hochma, and wide in Hassadim — her drop of redness is found to lack only the phase of the longness of Aba, in order to correct the phase of the shortness within her. Hence only that measure that the light of the coagulation of Aba coagulates from her is corrected from her drop of redness, for only this measure is completed in the phase of the longness of Aba, which is all the life of the fetus, as is known that the light of Aba is the phase of Chaya. Therefore this light of the coagulation of Aba is beloved, for it does not join in the building of the fetus except that measure that was coagulated by it. And this is the secret of the blood that comes out at the time of birth, for it is from the MAN of ZA and the redness of Ima, which the light of the coagulation of Aba did not reach and did not coagulate; hence they are moist and red, for they were not joined in the building of the fetus. And for this reason ZA is called a firmament — that is, on account of its reception of the coagulation of Aba. And understand this. (Part 1, Page 133, Item 21).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 138:1
items.html:
(to the question) The head of the small one
The head of the small one is the light of Ruach in the vessels of HBD. And it is a head only relative to the vessels; however, the lights are the essence, and therefore HBD are discerned only as HGT, and the head of the small one is only HGT, for the vessels that clothe the light of Ruach are called HGT. (Part 1, Page 164, Item 118).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 139:1
items.html:
(to the question) Reshit [beginning]
The Hochma of ZA is called Reshit. And this is because his light of Hochma clothes in his vessel of Keter. For Hochma does not clothe in the vessel of Hochma except only in AA, which is drawn from the phase corresponding to it from the Partzuf of Galgalta of AK. But in AVI, Hochma clothes in their Keter, because they are drawn from the phases corresponding to them from the AB of AK, in which the lights were exchanged: Hochma came in the vessel of Keter, and the light of Bina in Hochma. Therefore ZA, whose Mochin are drawn mainly from AVI, also has Hochma clothed in the vessel of Keter; and Hochma is found to be the beginning of the Partzuf in him. (Part 1, Page 163, Item 113).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 143:1
items.html:
(to the question) Shaddai with a dagesh
There is a Shaddai with a dagesh, and it is a holy name; and there is a Shaddai with a rafe, and it is the phase of the breasts for nursing, as it is written, "between my breasts he shall lodge." And their explanation is: for the way of Aba, who is AB, is to illuminate covered Hassadim in the HGT, and revealed Hassadim only in the NHY, as is known. And if the coupling of AVI is in the middle vessels, which are the HGT, and the vessels of NHY are not yet there, the two illuminations come there one after the other in the secret of the wavering ones, for they are wavered from mercy to judgment and from judgment to mercy. For at the time that the lights of the Hassadim are covered in the Achoraim of Ima, they are then in the phase of mercy, in the abundant expansion of the Hassadim. And if the illumination of AB is revealed in them, a sealing of the Hassadim is made in them, which is the measure of judgment, for they become lacking in the influence. And this is because of the dominion of the Achoraim of Ima there. For there is no place for the revelation of the illumination of AB except from the Chazeh downward, after the conclusion of the Yesod of Ima, as is known.

And the shadayim are called on account of the illumination of AB that begins to be revealed from there, in the secret of AB, 216, and 26, which in Gematria is Shaddai. As above, in answer 143. (Part 1, Page 240, Item 288).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 149:1
items.html:
(to the question) Torah
The Mochin of ZA are called by the name Torah. And this is in the secret of what our sages said: "the unripe fruits of the upper Hochma are Torah, and the unripe fruits of the upper Bina are the Shechina." The explanation: for fruits before the completion of their ripening are called unripe fruits. And it is known that the breaking of the vessels was because the vessels were small; but in the future, at the completion of the correction, after the vessels have grown in the world of correction, then BYA will return to be Atzilut, as it was before the breaking of the vessels, in the secret of "when the feet touch the feet," as is known. Hence the breaking was because the vessels received the great lights before they had grown all their need. And therefore this resembles unripe fruits. And it is known that the Achoraim of Aba, which were nullified at the time of the breaking of the vessels — from them come all the Mochin of ZA. Hence the unripe fruits of the upper Hochma, which are the nullified Achoraim of Aba — from them are drawn the Mochin of ZA, which are called Torah. And from the Achoraim of YESHSUT were made all the Mochin of the Nukva of ZA; and YESHSUT are Bina; hence the unripe fruits of the upper Bina are the Shechina. (Part 1, Page 131, Item 11).
